name: Super Dry
source:
The protagonist, Asahi Shinji, is a second-year highschooler with an extremely dry personality.
Despite avoiding involving himself with others due to personal reasons, strange guys keep flocking to him...?!
A straight-laced senior, his narcissistic homeroom teacher, an unwanted henchman of a junior...who will you grow close and open your heart to?

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/25454]Freem![/url]]
